Totals added by hand from those rows.
differs: Reasoning is inside output in Hermes (agent/usage_pricing.py normalize_usage), so reasoning_tokens is never added; ccusage, tokscale and TokenTracker all add it on top (ccusage total 1580 for session-1, ours 1570). We read session_model_usage like tokscale (auxiliary title/vision/compression calls live only there), and sessions totals only for sessions with no smu row; ccusage and TokenTracker read only sessions, so they miss the smu-only rows. ccusage also reads only <HERMES_HOME>/state.db, not profiles/*/state.db, hence its totals are the main DB alone. Cost per row is actual when > 0, else estimated (tokscale); ccusage takes actual.or(estimated) per session.
